args.final_thought:
Phase 1: Foundation & Shared Types is complete. All files created and verified:

**Enums** (6 files in `src/shared/types/`):
- `leave-status.enum.ts` — LeaveStatus: DRAFT | SUBMITTED | APPROVED | REJECTED | CANCELLED
- `leave-type.enum.ts` — LeaveType: annual | sick | emergency | unpaid | maternity | paternity
- `leave-action.enum.ts` — LeaveAction: CREATE | SUBMIT | APPROVE | REJECT | CANCEL | UPDATE | DELETE
- `notification-type.enum.ts` — NotificationType: LEAVE_SUBMITTED | LEAVE_APPROVED | LEAVE_REJECTED | LEAVE_CANCELLED | BALANCE_UPDATED
- `employment-status.enum.ts` — EmploymentStatus: ACTIVE | INACTIVE | TERMINATED
- `audit-action.enum.ts` — AuditAction: CREATE | UPDATE | DELETE | APPROVE | REJECT

**Barrel export**: `src/shared/types/index.ts` re-exports all 6 enums.

**Error types** (`src/shared/error-types.ts`): NotFoundError (404), ValidationError (422), ConflictError (409), UnauthorizedError (401) — all extend Error with `statusCode`.

**Base repository** (`src/shared/base-repository.ts`):
- `IBaseRepository<T>` interface with `findById` (returns T | null), `findAll`, `create` (accepts Omit<T, 'id'>, returns T with generated id), `update`, `delete` (returns boolean)
- `BaseRepository<T>` abstract class using the existing `pool` from `shared/db/connection`, with parameterized queries throughout

**Tests** (`tests/unit/shared/types/enums.test.ts`): 12 tests verifying every enum value exists and each enum has the correct count of members.

**Verification**: `tsc --noEmit` passes (0 errors), all 12 Jest tests pass.
